## The venue

::: callout-note
-   Our venue has changed! We will now be hosting in-person participants at 275 George Street, Brisbane. 
:::

The venue (275 George Street, Brisbane) is the location of Fisheries Queensland's head office. It is a short, 550m walk from Central train station, or 600m to Roma Street train station.

All public transport fares in Queensland cost 50 cents. Contactless payment is available on all South East Queensland (SEQ) trains, trams, ferries and buses---you can use your digital or physical bank card to tap on and off.

The workshop will be held in a boardroom on the 14th floor. Participants are to meet on the ground floor and a designated Queensland Government staff member will escort you in. Contact details for these staff members will be made available closer to the date. 

Wi-Fi will be available on site. 

## Food and drink

#### Lunch

There are ample eating options nearby. 

#### Dinner

Group dinners will be organised for each night from Monday to Thursday. These dinners are optional and will be pay-your-own-way. We will book restaurants within a 20-minute walking radius from the workshop and confirm numbers each morning.

If you have any dietary requirements that you would like to be considered when booking dinner locations, please contact us by 1 August.

#### Morning and afternoon tea

Tea and coffee will be provided on site.

## Accommodation

There are ample accommodation options, either walking distance or accessible via public transport.
